integrity: The proof reduces the population process to a four-transient-state absorbing chain. Exact integer-polynomial determinant identities are checked by included dependency-free Python code; independent eight-state exact checks supplement rather than replace the algebraic proof. External independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact theorem treats only three vertices, fixed start with the star, birth–death updating, integer dwell lengths one and two, and arbitrary positive fitness. No assertion for longer dwell, stochastic or phase-randomized schedules. Related published numerical cases at dwell lengths 1, 10 and 50 are explicitly credited. Priority beyond inspected literature remains uncertain.
title: A two-update reversal of selection on the smallest switching population network
